boundaries: Fake timers control 500ms/3000ms and watch debounce; actual filesystem IO, receipts, bytes/revisions/mtime/inodes and FSEvents remain real.
Synthetic DOM events prove production EditorView behavior in jsdom and are not physical keyboard/system IME or installed App proof.
No native save is mocked as successful. Protected unknown/recovery receipt cases are explicitly U guards with synthetic receipt state; their real checkpoint storage remains preserved.

H11 first two diagnostic failures used unwired low-level CodeMirror insertNewline/insertTab helpers. Production defaultKeymap uses insertNewlineAndIndent; corrected harness then passed actual mutation/paste/save checks. These harness failures are retained, not labeled a product defect.
A uses frozen r5; U/I uses its separately archived current sources. Later unrelated changes do not substitute for final package regression.

case.steps: 加载后不修改，反复手动保存/关tab。
case.expected: 无无谓write；关闭通过；不会改变mtime。
case.actual: txt/md/ts each 3 open-close cycles with 3 explicit saves per cycle (9 saves per suffix); all close, clean and reopen correctly. No service save/checkpoint calls. Hash, size, mtime and inode unchanged after 4000ms.
